description: Removes version check in atomic CAS dispatch

name: PID_ONLY_IDENTITY
description: Omits process start-time check, trusting PID alone

description: Permits SPEND_EUR without human gate if amount is zero or unspecified

description: Replaces hierarchical directory overlap check with exact string equality

description: Omits artifact checksum validation on completed task

description: Replays old result with non-zero exit code without validation

name: APPROVAL_REUSE_EXPIRED
description: Allows expired approval token

name: LEASE_EXPIRY_RETRY
description: Allows blind retry after lease failure without proof of non-effect

name: TIME_ONLY_KILL
description: Terminates stalled task on elapsed time alone without diagnostic evidence
